title: Check yourself: What each built-in tool is for, and how Edit fails

blocks.text: Questions on what this page has just taught. Choose one answer for each.

questions.stem: An agent must list every component's spec file in a repository, such as `Button.test.tsx`, wherever it sits. Which tool fits?

options.text: A content search for the string `describe(` or `it(`
options.says: Ruled out because a content search finds lines inside files: "Grep finds lines inside files" and not the names that match a pattern.

options.text: A name pattern search across every folder
options.says: The job is matching names, which is what a name pattern search is for.

options.text: A full read of each folder in turn
options.says: Ruled out because a folder cannot be read: the table's "Reads files, not directories".

options.text: A shell loop that opens each file in turn
options.says: Ruled out because opening every file spends the context on files that do not matter: "it spends the context on files that do not matter".

questions.stem: A `routes.yaml` made of ten identical blocks that differ only by position refuses an edit to the third block, because the text to replace appears ten times. So no snippet of reasonable length around the third block is unique. What should the agent do?

options.text: Read it and write the whole thing again with the one alteration
options.says: The guide keys Read plus Write as the fallback for a non-unique Edit, and here no unique anchor exists. The product's documented remedies are a longer unique string or `replace_all`; Read plus Write is the guide's route when neither applies, and it is where this case lands.

options.text: Retry with `replace_all` set, then repair the nine others by hand
options.says: Ruled out because "`replace_all` changes every occurrence, which is right for a rename and wrong when only one of three similar lines should change."

options.text: Widen the snippet with more surrounding lines until it is unique
options.says: Ruled out because the page names this very case as the one for the fallback: "for example when a file is made of repeated blocks that differ only by position".

options.text: Use a content search to locate the third block, then retry unchanged
options.says: Ruled out because "Grep finds lines inside files" and does not change them, so the retried edit would be refused again.
